brief: How we got our first 100 customers — no ads, no SEO, just 6 channels.

slots.author: Maya Chen
slots.headline: How We Got Our First 100 Customers
slots.body: We skipped paid ads and SEO. Instead, we focused on six high-trust channels that delivered our first 100 paying customers in 90 days.

slots.author: Maya Chen
slots.title: Tap Your Personal Network First
slots.body: We emailed every former colleague and friend. Warm intros converted at 40% because trust was already built. Don't underestimate who already knows you.

slots.author: Maya Chen
slots.title: Join Communities Where They Hang
slots.body: We added value in 5 niche Slack and Reddit groups before ever pitching. When we did share, it felt like advice, not spam.

slots.author: Maya Chen
slots.title: Partner With Complementary Tools
slots.body: We reached out to founders offering adjacent services. A simple co-marketing swap put us in front of 2,000 qualified leads overnight.

slots.author: Maya Chen
slots.title: Hyper-Personalized Cold Outreach
slots.body: We sent 20 highly personalized DMs daily. Each message referenced a specific pain point from their public content. Reply rate hit 35%.

slots.author: Maya Chen
slots.title: Build In Public Daily
slots.body: We shared metrics, failures, and lessons on LinkedIn. Transparent storytelling created an audience that converted into early adopters without a funnel.

slots.author: Maya Chen
slots.title: Turn Users Into Advocates
slots.body: After ten customers, we asked for introductions. One happy user referred three new ones. Incentives helped, but genuine love closed the deal.

slots.author: Maya Chen
slots.headline: Which Channel Will You Try First
slots.body: Pick one tactic and run it for 30 days. Reply with your choice and I will share our exact outreach template.
